subject.title: fix(discord): bound webhook send body reads

question: Should Discord webhook sends fail locally after the fixed 15-second deadline even though a request accepted remotely may have produced a message whose outcome the caller cannot determine?
rationale: This is a user-visible delivery-semantics choice rather than a mechanical timeout bug: the patch trades an unbounded wait for a bounded but potentially ambiguous non-idempotent send.

options.title: Accept the bounded-send contract
options.body: Keep the fixed 15-second deadline, document the ambiguous-outcome retry risk in the PR evidence, and require current-head loopback proof.

options.title: Preserve the existing unbounded wait
options.body: Do not add a webhook wall-clock deadline until the Discord delivery/retry contract has a separately approved idempotency strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded-send contract
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed 15-second deadline, document the ambiguous-outcome retry risk in the PR evidence, and require current-head loopback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation author can supply the missing exact-head proof, while repository maintainers retain the final delivery-contract decision.
